dedupe_keys.name: kwb r kwb promisces emission model kwb promisces emission model v0 1 0 emission model to calculate the monthly load of pollutants entering various water bodies and watercourses via stormwater and wastewater

description: Franziska Knoche and colleagues at Kompetenzzentrum Wasser Berlin publish a PROMISCES emissions model. Zenodo archives version 0.1.0 under CC BY 4.0 and links a public repository. The description states that the model calculates monthly pollutant loads reaching water bodies through separate storm sewers, combined sewer overflows and treated wastewater effluent. It can supply receiving-water quality scenarios or test how different drainage and treatment pathways change pollutant loading. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this PROMISCES module. Coverage and pollutant selection depend on separately supplied model inputs, whose download link is in the public description. A limitation is that neither the Zenodo abstract nor the short repository README lists every parameter, receiving basin or calibration period. The model is a monthly load accounting tool, not a dynamic sewer hydraulics simulator. The archive and inputs were not downloaded, and no mass balance or observed concentration comparison was reproduced.
